items.root_cause: Two stacked causes. (1) The 07:00 [ad] run executed 2026-09-23 10:39 code because the checkout had not moved since then (the 09-23 harvest and graph bots commit without pushing, and no capture-run synced), so the autostash-rebase tail that W4.2 deleted ran once more and did what W4.2 was written to stop: its autostash pop conflicted on a foreign uncommitted edit to ops/test-prepush-hook.ps1 and left the shared checkout unmerged. That shape cannot recur now that W4.1/W4.2 are in HEAD. (2) The mechanism that stranded the refresh for the rest of the day: once a daily run COMPLETES with its commit unlanded (a tail sync blocked by foreign work, a refused push), nothing retries the push. Test-AlreadyRanToday skips every later hourly occurrence on stage=complete whatever the exit code, so 11:00-14:00 exited 0 as no-ops while the blocker went away. The class: any committed-but-unlanded bot run waits for the next morning, whatever made the push fail - which is also what 2026-09-19-c7c57d (an untracked blocker) and 2026-09-21-5ac200 (a pre-push refusal) were.

root_fix.what: a push-only retry: an hourly occurrence that finds today's run complete, committed and not landed runs the tail sync and push, and nothing else
root_fix.exact_change: (a) record the landing in capture-run-status.json <kind>: committed_sha and pushed (true|false), written where the tail already knows them ($botCommitted and the push outcome the edge check logs as 'pushed=False'). (b) Test-AlreadyRanToday returns a third verdict 'push-retry' when date == today AND stage == complete AND committed_sha is set AND pushed is false; every other case is unchanged (a pushed or never-committed complete run still returns 'already ran today', so a guards-blocked morning still never re-pulls the stores, the 2026-09-10 reason for the skip). (c) on 'push-retry': take Global\tc-capture-run as the full run does, fetch, and if `git rev-list --count origin/main..<committed_sha>` is 0 (another push carried it; unpushed is not private here) record pushed=true and exit 0; otherwise run the SAME tail the full run uses (Invoke-TcCheckoutSync tail, then the push with its re-sync attempts), append one line to that day's capture-run log, record the outcome, exit 0 on a landed push and 1 on a still-blocked one, and page only on a CHANGE of blocking reason, not every hour. No capture lane, no chain, no stage change.

items.root_cause: export-feed replaces the two served feed copies, which other processes read all day, with bare [IO.File]::WriteAllText. That throws when another handle holds or maps the file (the exact error that killed two chain audits on 09-23), and a throw is not a refusal: it lands as exit 1 BETWEEN the two writes, leaves out\ and public\ disagreeing, and the caller's reason-picker prints an informational line, so a transient held file reads as a refusal and holds the WHOLE board instead of retrying. UNPROVEN: the exact exception at 09:19:36 was not recorded; a reader holding or mapping public\smp-feed.json is the probable cause (file state plus the 09-23 twin), not a proven one.

surface_fix.what: none on its own: the recovery run in 924782 re-exports; this item makes that export survive a held file

root_fix.what: write both served copies through Write-TcAtomicFile (retry on a held or mapped file), public\ first; a write that still fails prints a named FAILED verdict and exits 3; the chain reports that line, never an informational one

The served feed stands.' items.root_cause: A recipe's publish state lives on two roads. The hold's first half (db/held-recipes.json) is TRACKED and reached main by commit; its second half (removing the slug from db/published-hashes.json) is a GITIGNORED file, so the removal stayed in the worktree that ran hold-recipe and never reached the main checkout. Every main-checkout reader that takes published-hashes.json as 'the published set' then reports held drafts as live. The class: any hold applied from a linked worktree, which is where the money lane runs.

surface_fix.what: covered by the root fix's first run: it removes the 11 keys from the main checkout's published-hashes.json

root_fix.what: reconcile the untracked half from the tracked half in the main checkout's own chain: remove from published-hashes.json every slug listed in held-recipes.json, before any reader of the published set runs
root_fix.exact_change: hold-recipe.ps1: add -Reconcile (dry run by default, -Apply writes) that loads db/held-recipes.json and db/published-hashes.json, removes every held slug still keyed in the hashes, writes through Write-TcAtomicFile (keeping a .bak on first -Apply), and prints one line per slug plus 'HOLD-RECONCILE-COMPLETE held=N removed=M'. Safe by the file's own ordering argument (header lines 23-32): publish.ps1 refuses a held slug, so a missing hash cannot trigger a republish. check-ad-cycles.ps1: call it with -Apply in the recipe stage before export-feed and audit-live-price-contract; a non-zero exit is logged, never fatal to the board.
